news.text: LUCIO HITS ROCK BOTTOMThird KO in 9 matchesHe lost 2-0 at the Marassi: already 11 points behind #Inter and #Lazio.#Juve nightmare: another flop. Outclassed by #DeRossi.Embarrassing display and a defense in shambles. #Genoa scores with #Ehizibue and #Baldanzi. #Spalletti is at risk: rumors about #Sousa and #Pioli. Sunday's clash with #Napoli will be decisive.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

CHILLING(A catchphrase used by #Conte during a famous press conference)A horrific #Juve humiliated by a great #Genoa: #Spalletti in tilt. #DeRossi mortifies the maestro Lucio: -11 from #Inter and #Lazio. #Ehizibue and #Baldanzi electrify the Marassi, the bianconeri's submissiveness in challenges, the balls passed to opponents, and the slow rhythm against the rossoblù's aggressiveness are disconcerting. The faces of #Carnevali, #Massara and #Ferrero say it all: now it is time to reflect. The coach: "I apologize to the fans. Little substance, little fight".[Front Page TuttoSport]

🧐❗️"The possibility of #ManchesterUnited changing their manager is concrete, but at the moment there is nothing with #Conte. This could interest #Juventus, should an opportunity open up: they have always shown total faith in #Spalletti, choosing to give him time and trust, reassuring him and placing responsibility on the players without contacting other coaches. But now a real turning point is needed, otherwise he is risking heavily."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔛🆙 "#Juventus has already realized the need to intervene in the January mercato: the club has already evaluated internally that they want to use the winter mercato window to fix something, because this team absolutely needs it, considering the many injured players."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👨‍🦲😤 "The trust in #Spalletti has never been under discussion until today, but the performance in Genoa has left great dissatisfaction even at the management level: they are not happy and expect something different. With so many matches close together, it is not easy to make deep evaluations regarding a potential coaching change. The international break is getting closer and we will see what the situation looks like by then, but the manager will have to change gears, otherwise his position could truly begin to crack."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "Am I still sure that I am the right persont o shake up this team? We have changed very little because these are the players we have. We can make a different substitution by playing one or two different players. From my point of view, regarding being the right person, yes. In my opinion, it would be difficult for anyone given the current situation, but possibilities exist. I think I have somewhat of an advantage because I know where this thing originated from and I know my players. However, this is an evaluation that anyone can make. Anyone's opinion is accepted".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "#DeRossi said that half of a strong #Juventus team is out? It is clear that if I had to analyze my team right now, I would make that analysis. It is a somewhat particular situation but if we stand there thinking about what happened to us and what we didn't notice at the moment instead of being firmly focused on searching for the solution, we waste more time and create more confusion. Because of this, now we have a very difficult, but beautiful match against a very strong team and we must organize ourselves against a team that has the exact same points as we do".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "Teams like #Sassuolo, #Genoa etc... They understood this type of football and we didn't? It's a bit of a recurring theme, this issue of the fight and the physical challenge. Last Sunday, for three-quarters of the match we understood it, but tonight we did not reach the level that the game required as a necessity. From the standpoint of being followed by the team, absolutely yes: the players participate, they are people with whom I have the opportunity to speak. However, we must do something different. Then, regarding this statement that it's a bit of the same story coming out, it is true that we have lost three matches but it has been like this

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "Today's defeat? The first thing to do is to apologize to the fans. Then I am open to talking about anything regarding the team, behavior and play on the pitch. But if we have to talk about the difficulties we had tonight, it is quite easy. We were not at the level of physical impact and duels. From an intensity standpoint, we lost everything that could translate the match into play. If every ball that is thrown forward cannot be played and if for every ball they hammer behind us we have to bring the whole team to get it, it becomes difficult. I absolutely must do something different. However, there are causes that have brought us to this point a

🗣 Weston #Mckennie to 'Sky Sport': "Do tactics in these cases don't matter much or can they send us into a bit of confusion? No, for me it has nothing to do with it. In the end, as you said before, we are eleven players on the pitch. Tactics help, but making an extra five or ten meters makes the difference, it's not tactics. You need aggression to close out games, to finish plays, to run backward, to fight for your teammate. This is what we have to do: simply do more, because we are #Juventus and it is not acceptable for #Juventus to take to the pitch and have these ups and downs. #Juventus is a club with a great history and many victories. We must return to winning with greater continuity a

🗣 Weston #Mckennie to 'Sky Sport': "Why is the desire to fight missing? I don't know, I am speaking in general. I try to talk inside the locker room to inject energy, to do more. When you go out on the pitch, though, talking no longer exists: we simply have to execute, every single one of us".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "Is there something that worries me? What worries me is that it's difficult to make them understand where football has gone. Before talking about other situations you have to go and win these duels, nowadays everyone does it this way and even when we go to try to do it in training it becomes difficult, although right now it's been a while since we've trained because we don't have logical replacements to balance out the fatigue, there are too many absences. This worries me a little bit, but every time you have to take a small step forward to do something different. However, that would require time and that is something we do not have".[@juventusinsidernews]

#McKennie: “We must do better and do more. Today we did not do well. We need a reaction: we need to be more aggressive during the match. Tactics have nothing to do with it in games like this: we need to struggle, run and fight. #Genoa did that well today and we didn't. Against #Napoli it will be a difficult match but we need to win”. #Juventus[Nico Schira]

#Spalletti: “We are unable to train due to the many absences. I don't know if I'm capable of giving what is needed. We are trying to do something different, but it would require time and unfortunately you don't have it…”. #Juventus[Nico Schira]

#Spalletti: “I will experience the match against #Napoli with great emotion and a strong feeling toward a city that is impossible not to love if you live in it and have won a championship there. What worries me is that it's difficult to make people understand where football has gone: you have to win individual duels.”[Nico Schira]

#Spalletti: “We played a part in the goals we conceded and wasted two good opportunities in the first half. Did we bring too little of everything? We have to see if the players actually have any of that 'everything' in them at this moment. We were lightweight, with very little fight: it's been like this since the beginning of the year.” #Juve[Nico Schira]

#Spalletti: “I apologize to the fans for the performance: that is the first thing to do. Everything that is said right now could turn out to be wrong. There is a need for some time to focus on the situation. We failed to find the correct balance to contain #Baldanzi” #Juve[Nico Schira]
